messages.subject: Model Averaging with spOccupancy
parts:
Good morning spOccupancy!

I hope this message finds you well.

I have a question regarding the use of model averaging for models fit with the stPGOcc function in spOccupancy. I have previously used the AICcmodavg package to model average stacked unmarked models, but wasn't sure if there was an equivalent approach for  models generated with spOccupancy. Though it worth asking.

Thank you for your continued support and time.

- Chris

messages.subject: Re: Model Averaging with spOccupancy
parts:
Hi Chris, 

No, there is unfortunately no functionality for doing model averaging with spOccupancy functions. It's not on my current todo list of things to implement in the future, but of course if anyone else wanted to try and implement it that'd be great.

Cheers,

Jeff
